digest.component_or_area: fallback model orchestration and rebar configuration
propositions: Approved direct-Anthropic fallback arms must be enabled in rebar.toml for frontier and standard model classes, with trivial remaining single-armed until direct Haiku parity is measured

Whole-chain capability intersection currently silently downgrades primary model capabilities to match fallback candidates before any attempt, collapsing native structured output to prompted output for standard class
Direct Anthropic Sonnet has been live-proven to support native structured output and thinking without credential exposure, resolving the prior capability asymmetry via measured exact-ID metadata
Mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains must conservatively disable prompt caching due to provider-specific cache style differences

The fallback orchestration mechanism cannot adapt request shape per attempt without explicit redesign, making per-attempt capability resolution a future enhancement beyond this class-scoped configuration
